steps: open the workshop (mechas workshop) and the slip creator
draw a first 16x16 creature; meet at least one refusal and fix it from the validator's words
author the species SLIP (palettes, mass bounds, organ roles, mutation caps, behavior/survival weights, deliberation depth) until the authority accepts it
save the creature with its semantic layers
scrub a clip on the timeline (onion skin on) and adjust the anchor until the motion reads
release the creature into the ecosystem
export the animated APNG carrying the scrubbed clip
record total wall-clock against the 45-minute bound
human_pass.note: the scripted proxy proves the PATH and counts the interactions; only a human pass measures the 45-minute goal for real — prepared here, recorded not blocking (the calibration pattern)
